name: How do I prepare my home for a kitchen expansion project?

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home for a kitchen expansion project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a kitchen expansion project begins, it's crucial to clear the immediate work area, secure valuables, and establish a temporary cooking setup if needed. Disconnecting and moving appliances, emptying cabinets, and protecting adjacent rooms from dust and debris are also important steps. Hometelligent Inc. will provide a detailed checklist of preparation tasks tailored to your project during the pre-construction phase to ensure a smooth start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing the work area, securing valuables, setting up a temporary kitchen, and protecting adjacent rooms from dust.
